label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — User input from request.getParameter flows through doSomething() where bar is assigned either param directly or param.substring(0, param.length()-1). The resolved sink value is bar.toCharArray() which outputs the modified string to response.getWriter(). The substring operation only removes the last character, leaving attacker-controlled content intact. No HTML encoding occurs between source and sink. This is a genuine XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: doSomething() receives param and returns bar (either param or param.substring(0, param.length()-1))
Sink: bar.toCharArray() writes user-controlled content to response without HTML encoding
